summary: Capricor Therapeutics filed an 8-K to announce publication of Phase 3 HOPE-3 trial results in The Lancet and an FDA BIMO inspection conclusion. The publication reports an updated statistical model for LVEF with p=0.09 versus p=0.04 previously; primary endpoint unchanged. FDA issued one Form 483 observation related to SOPs and documentation practices; company disputes data integrity impact. This is a clinical/regulatory update, not a special-situation corporate event. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic transactions are involved. Watch for FDA BLA review progress and potential regulatory implications.
